# BladeForums.com

> > The leading community marketplace and discussion forum for knife enthusiasts, collectors, and dealers worldwide.

BladeForums.com is a comprehensive knife trading and discussion community featuring dedicated marketplaces for production knives, custom blades, and knifemaking services. The site maintains strong community safeguards through reputation tracking, fraud documentation, and specialized forums for major knife brands and individual sellers.

## Community Trust & Safety

- [FEEDBACK: The Good, The Bad, The Ugly!](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/feedback-the-good-the-bad-the-ugly.699): Community feedback forum for dealer & seller reputation tracking
- [Hall of Fame](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/hall-of-fame.802): Consolidated positive feedback for trusted dealers and sellers
- [Hall of Shame](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/hall-of-shame.803): Fraud documentation and scam prevention resource for community

## Dealer Marketplace

- [For Sale: Production Knives (Dealer)](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/for-sale-production-knives-dealer.749): Dealer marketplace for production knives (Spyderco, Microtech, WE)
- [For Sale: Custom & Semi Production Knives (Dealer)](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/for-sale-custom-semi-production-knives-dealer.751): Dealer marketplace for custom and semi-production knives
- [For Sale: Gadgets & Gear (Dealer)](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/for-sale-gadgets-gear-dealer.763): Dealer marketplace for knife accessories and non-knife merchandise

## Individual Seller Marketplace

- [For Sale: Folders](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/for-sale-folders.753): Community marketplace for buying and selling folding knives
- [For Sale: Fixed Blades](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/for-sale-fixed-blades.754): Community marketplace for buying and selling fixed blade knives
- [For Sale: Fixed Blades (Individual)](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/for-sale-fixed-blades-individual.891): Individual seller marketplace for fixed blade knives
- [For Sale: Folding Knives (Individual)](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/for-sale-folding-knives-individual.892): Individual seller marketplace for folding knives and midtechs
- [For Sale: Kitchen Knives](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/for-sale-kitchen-knives.890): Marketplace for kitchen knives including chef and damascus blades
- [For Sale: Gadgets & Gear](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/for-sale-gadgets-gear.832): Community marketplace for swords, sheaths, and knife accessories

## Brand-Specific Marketplaces

- [Buck Knives For Sale](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/buck-knives-for-sale.798): Specialized marketplace for buying and selling Buck brand knives
- [Busse / Swamprat / Scrapyard Knives For Sale](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/busse-swamprat-scrapyard-knives-for-sale.804): Specialized marketplace for Busse, Swamprat, and Scrapyard knives
- [Chris Reeve Knives for sale](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/chris-reeve-knives-for-sale.916): Specialized marketplace for Chris Reeve brand knives (Gold+ only)
- [Carothers Performance Knives For Sale](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/carothers-performance-knives-for-sale.967): Specialized marketplace for Carothers Performance brand knives

## Knifemaking & Custom Services

- [The Custom Shop: Services Offered](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/the-custom-shop-services-offered.870): Forum for customizers offering embellishment and spec work services
- [Wanted: Knifemaker / Craftsman / Related Services](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/wanted-knifemaker-craftsman-related-services.871): Forum for requesting custom knifemaking and craftsman services
- [For Sale: Knifemaking Supplies & Tools](https://www.bladeforums.com/forums/for-sale-knifemaking-supplies-tools.765): Marketplace for knifemaking equipment, supplies, and tools
